title: Remove App/Event dropdown from Single Comment Generator in User View

requirements.summary: Remove the App/Event dropdown selector from the Single Comment Generator section in UserView.tsx and update the Comment List dropdown to show all unlocked comment lists from all apps/events instead of filtered lists
acceptanceCriteria: The Single Comment Generator card in the User View tab does not contain an App/Event dropdown.
The 'Select Comment List' dropdown in the Single Comment Generator shows all unlocked comment lists regardless of app/event.
The Available Comments count, device lock notice, Generate Single Comment button, copy output, and out-of-comments badge all continue to function correctly.
App/Event selectors in other tabs (Live Checker, Upload/Bulk Comment Generator, etc.) are unaffected.
No console errors related to undefined selectedApp or app-event filtering in the Single Comment Generator.

file_operations.description: Remove the App/Event dropdown selector (<select> element with id 'app-event') from the Single Comment Generator card. Remove the selectedApp state variable and its setter. Update the Comment List dropdown to show all unlocked comment lists by removing the filter condition that checks appEvent.name === selectedApp. Remove any conditional logic that depends on selectedApp being set. Ensure all other functionality (available count display via getAvailableCount query, device lock notice using useDeviceId, Generate Single Comment button with useCommentGenerator, copy output with toast feedback, out-of-comments badge) remains unchanged. Do not modify the App/Event selector in the embedded TopDownShooter game section or any other part of the component.
